name: handoff-button
description: ⌾: /advisor with the chosen model (right click: pick Opus, Sonnet or Haiku for this chat). C: /compact now (right click: compact when idle for this chat, 10 minutes after a reply when the context is half full; the C turns red). H: asks for a handover (right click: full handover mode, shown as ⤓: compact, rename to [A], start chat [B] with the handover, archive the old one). Thumb: types "Yes, please". A short hint shows on hover. Shows other mods' buttons (bright-buttons) left of them.
